title: Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease Relationship Credit on Closed-End Early Termination
content:
# Relationship Program Bulletin — Termination Credit for Businesses Holding Kestrel Retail and Balloon Contracts

**Rule.** For the early termination charge on a closed-end commercial unit of the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease ended before its scheduled end date by a turn-in or by a recovery after an uncured default, the termination relationship credit is $200 where the business holds both an active Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract and an active Kestrel Advantage Balloon contract, $100 where it holds exactly one of the two, and nothing where it holds neither.

**Which contracts.** A Kestrel Advantage Balloon contract is a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract. What is read is whether the business, as the customer on those contracts, holds one whose status is active. A contract that is paid off or otherwise no longer active does not count.

## Holdings table

| Active Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract held | Active Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract held | Termination relationship credit |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | $200 |
| Yes | No | $100 |
| No | Yes | $100 |
| No | No | nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical)

1. A business holds two active retail installment contracts and no balloon contract: it holds exactly one of the two kinds, so the credit is $100. The number of contracts of one kind does not raise the credit.
2. A business holds an active balloon contract and a retail installment contract that was paid off last year: only the balloon contract is active, so the credit is $100.
3. A business holds an active contract of each kind: $200.
